en-US.title: Learnly: Adaptive Learning
en-US.subtitle: Lessons that adapt to you
en-US.description:
Learnly finds your starting point with a short, no-pressure placement check, then paces lessons and practice to exactly what you need next.

- Adaptive practice that stays challenging but never discouraging
- Mastery rings, streaks and XP that make progress visible
- Works offline: download lessons and keep practicing anywhere, then sync when you're back online
- Warm, encouraging feedback with worked explanations
- Built for everyone: screen reader support, large text, reduced motion, English, Español and Filipino

es-MX.title: Learnly: aprendizaje adaptativo
es-MX.subtitle: Lecciones que se adaptan a ti
es-MX.description: Learnly encuentra tu punto de partida con una evaluación breve y sin presión, y adapta las lecciones y la práctica a lo que necesitas a continuación. Funciona sin conexión y sincroniza tu progreso cuando vuelves a estar en línea.

review.notes: Use the demo account. Toggle airplane mode while practicing to see offline sync.
